history.note: ending phase split into ending-step/expiration-step so 'this turn' effects expire after end-of-turn triggers

Splitting the ending phase into ending-step/expiration-step (expiry extracted to runExpirationStep, run after the end-of-turn chain empties) makes the target test pass but breaks 316.3 (opponent energy floated in the Beginning Phase survives into Main), sfd-109-221 Akshan (power floated during Aurora's end-of-turn trigger), and additional-turn tests 737/738 (flow step transitions interact with transitionToNextTurn). Reverted.
